scope: Close the six reported backend deficiencies; preserve frontends and their existing live connections. This is not a claim that all 289 desktop RPC commands are interchangeable with REST.

closedIssues.result: Value-weighted negative adjustments avoid overdrawing cheaper layers; exact-cent residual, zero-pool, actual supplier variance/return, transit and policy-CAS cases passed. Historical postings unchanged.

Durable restricted-worker queues, stable provider keys, leases, bounded retries, unknown outcomes, sender/recipient rechecks, public token date updates and management notifications implemented; three fake-provider acceptances per workflow run, no real external transport.
Calendar expiry begins after confirmed acceptance. Quotes use one deadline for staff/portal views, conversion and commercial holds; orders are never automatically cancelled.

Warehouse-scoped private upload, verified-photo gate, named handwritten handover proof, pending requests, versioned processing/rejection, no posting during submission, and native stock/accounting checks implemented.

Invoice and statement frozen PDFs, reviewable mail body/attachment identity, explicit confirmation, ten-minute preview expiry, source/permission revalidation before and after rendering, fenced delivery and uncertain-outcome retention implemented.
Both tax bases passed full compatibility and final feature workflows; 50 unit tests, 69 cold/repeatable migrations, isolated image deployment/legacy runtime recovery, and CI snapshot reuse passed.
